Mridul Tiwari is an Indian YouTuber and digital content creator known for his comedy videos and participation in the reality show Bigg Boss 19.
Early life and education
Mridul was born in Etawah, Uttar Pradesh, in a middle-class family. His father, Raghvendra Tiwari, and mother, Shashi Tiwari, supported his early career. His sister, Pragati Tiwari, is also a well-known YouTuber and often appears in his videos. He completed his schooling in Greater Noida and graduated from Meerut University.
Career
Tiwari began his career as an independent content creator on YouTube, producing comedy sketches that often blend rural and urban lifestyle themes. In March 2026, his high-tech residence in Noida gained media attention when choreographer Farah Khan visited and shared a house tour, which subsequently went viral.
Mridul started his digital journey in October 2018 with his YouTube channel "The MriDul". His content primarily revolves around the daily lives and comedy of North Indian middle-class families.
Bigg Boss 19
In 2026, Tiwari participated as a contestant in the 19th season of the Indian reality show Bigg Boss. His stint on the show was marked by several controversies. His eviction from the show was criticized by a section of the audience as "unfair," leading to significant social media debate. Following his exit, Tiwari made allegations against the show's producers regarding the editing of his segments.
Controversies
Tiwari was involved in a controversy regarding his film titled Yadavji Ki Love Story. Protests were held in the Sambhal district of Uttar Pradesh demanding a ban on the film. He later issued a statement urging the public not to spread misinformation regarding the project.
Lamborghini Accident (2025)
In May 2025, Mridul was involved in a road accident in Noida when his high-speed Lamborghini injured two people. The incident received significant media coverage from outlets like NDTV.
Philanthropy
In January 2026, Tiwari was reported to have distributed blankets to the underprivileged in Noida on the occasion of the New Year, an act that received positive coverage in the media.
Lifestyle and Assets
Mridul is known for his luxurious lifestyle. According to The Times of India, he owns a Lamborghini worth approximately ₹4.5 crore, along with other luxury cars such as a BMW and a Porsche.
